dedupe_keys.name: inspire data specification on hydrography technical guidelines for european hydrographic network data

description: The INSPIRE data specification on Hydrography, published by the INSPIRE Maintenance and Implementation Group, sets out the technical guidelines that European public authorities follow when they publish hydrographic data under the INSPIRE Directive. The version read was published on 31 January 2024 and is linked to its source files on GitHub. Coverage: the European Union member states, whose national hydrographic data are published to this model in INSPIRE services. Format and access: the guidelines are a free document, with application schemas maintained on GitHub; data following them are found through the INSPIRE geoportal and national services. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): CC-BY-4.0 unless otherwise indicated (European Commission reuse policy). Caveats: this is a specification, not a dataset; the model contents were not read, and national data vary in completeness and in how closely they follow the guidelines. Simulation uses: a common model for river networks and water bodies that lets flood, drought and water supply models combine data across countries. Related records: the EEA WISE Freshwater information system (data-eea-wise-freshwater-information-system) reports water data across Europe, and HydroRIVERS (data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins) is a global river network.
